summary: @or-sdk/tables preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes an obfuscated 727 KB sibling payload
details: The package declares a `preinstall` script (`node setup.mjs`) that downloads a platform-specific Bun runtime zip from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases, extracts the `bun` binary to a temp directory, marks it executable, and then invokes that Bun binary against a package-local file `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a ~727 KB heavily obfuscated bundle (string-array with a rotate-shift decoder and mangled identifiers such as `MmgoCP`, `etDiOOB`, `hc1jfK9`, `WV8StW`) whose behavior is not inspectable from the shipped source. The package's declared purpose is an SDK for `tables` and has no need for a second language runtime at install time. Fetching Bun from its official domain is not the concern; the concern is that Bun is used to execute an obfuscated, purpose-mismatched sibling script that will not be inspected by the installer's Node-based tooling, on every `npm install` of this version.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
